name: twolay
description: Offline two-way Deaf <-> Blind communicator: 17 FSL signs plus your own, local Whisper, Kokoro voice, English <-> Filipino translation, phone-to-phone link.

scripts.start:lan: python3 scripts/build_manifest.py && python3 scripts/serve.py --lan --cert certs/cert.pem --key certs/key.pem
scripts.test:setup: cd test && npm install && npx playwright install chromium && bash make_media.sh
scripts.test: cd test && node e2e.mjs && node e2e-offline.mjs && node e2e-p2p.mjs && node e2e-train.mjs && node e2e-voice.mjs && node e2e-translate.mjs && node e2e-vad.mjs
scripts.build:pack: bash scripts/fsl105/prepare.sh && node scripts/fsl105/build_pack.mjs && python3 scripts/build_manifest.py
